title: 膨脹性地層隧道設計
summary: 本課以區分膨脹礦物、水源與受限變形的隧道設計為主線，從礦物反應與含水條件與自由膨脹與試體方向建立系統邊界，再把水源路徑與暴露量、仰拱拘束與接觸壓力連到長期維護與反應地圖。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish swelling minerals, water supply and restrained deformation in tunnel design. It begins with Mineral reactions and water conditions and Free swell and specimen direction, links Water pathways and exposure volume and Invert restraint and contact pressure, and ends with Long-term maintenance and reaction maps. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查礦物反應與含水條件：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent；再獨立檢查自由膨脹與試體方向：freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent。100 mm 試體自由高度增量由 4 增為 6 mm，膨脹率由 4% 增為 6%；不能推論受限壓力也增加 50%，因為邊界和反應非線性。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 將比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Mineral reactions and water conditions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Independently check Free swell and specimen direction: freeSwell=heightIncrease/initialHeight=4 mm/100 mm=4 percent. Increasing free height change from 4 to 6 mm in a 100 mm specimen raises swell from 4% to 6%; restrained pressure need not rise by 50% because boundary and response are nonlinear. The two results are not a complete design because free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. Use compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「礦物反應與含水條件」與「自由膨脹與試體方向」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mineral reactions and water conditions" and "Free swell and specimen direction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「礦物反應與含水條件」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mineral reactions and water conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膨脹可能來自黏土吸水或礦物轉化，兩者對水化學、時間與應力狀態的反應不同。岩樣外觀不足以判別機制，需把礦物組成和取樣保存狀態一起記錄；遇水變形也可能混有軟化及崩解，不能都用同一膨脹係數描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄；若出現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「礦物反應與含水條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Swelling may arise from clay hydration or mineral transformation, with different sensitivity to chemistry, time and stress. Appearance alone does not identify the mechanism; document mineralogy and sample preservation. Wetting deformation can also contain softening and slaking rather than a single swelling coefficient. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mineral reactions and water conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「礦物反應與含水條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mineral reactions and water conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「礦物反應與含水條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waterContent=(wetMass-dryMass)/dryMass=(120-100) g/100 g=20 percent. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「礦物反應與含水條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「礦物反應與含水條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mineral reactions and water conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「礦物反應與含水條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mineral reactions and water conditions"?
options: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束
optionsEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended
quiz.explanation: 將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 礦物反應與含水條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mineral reactions and water conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「礦物反應與含水條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mineral reactions and water conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record mineral analysis, natural water content and sample-sealing time together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將礦物分析、天然含水率與取樣密封時間共同記錄；若出現樣本乾燥改變初始狀態，試驗反應無法代表原位地層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If sample drying changes its initial state and makes the test unrepresentative of ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只看岩石外觀就能準確判斷所有膨脹機制」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rock appearance alone accurately identifies every swelling mechanism" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「受限膨脹與反力」與「力學軟化與膨脹區分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Restrained swell and reaction" and "Softening versus swelling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Restrained swell and reaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「受限膨脹與反力」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained swell and reaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。完全零變形是理想化，微小試架變形可能降低量得壓力；應將反力和位移一起呈現，不能只保留單一峰值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間；若出現試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「受限膨脹與反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path. Perfect zero displacement is idealized; small frame deformation can reduce measured pressure. Report reaction and movement together rather than a peak alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. If frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained swell and reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「受限膨脹與反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrained swell and reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 受限膨脹與反力
knowledge.text: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。完全零變形是理想化，微小試架變形可能降低量得壓力；應將反力和位移一起呈現，不能只保留單一峰值。
knowledge.textEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path. Perfect zero displacement is idealized; small frame deformation can reduce measured pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「受限膨脹與反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Restrained swell and reaction" is correct?
options: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。
受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響
遇水後產生的任何變形都只能叫做膨脹
optionsEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path.
Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness
Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling
quiz.explanation: 限制變形的試驗量到維持邊界所需反力，結果受到儀器剛度、允許位移及浸水路徑影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A restrained test measures reaction needed to maintain a boundary, depending on apparatus stiffness, permitted movement and wetting path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Restrained swell and reaction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「受限膨脹與反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained swell and reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「受限膨脹與反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Restrained swell and reaction", which statement holds?
options: 地表隆起除以總覆土就能得到唯一膨脹率
原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。
觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束
optionsEn: Surface heave divided by total cover gives the unique swelling strain
Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa.
A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: swellingPressure=force/area=25 kN/0.005 m2=5 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Restrained swell and reaction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「受限膨脹與反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained swell and reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「受限膨脹與反力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Restrained swell and reaction"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
裂縫修補完成就代表膨脹地層已經永久穩定
校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Completing crack repairs proves the swelling ground is permanently stable
Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together.
quiz.explanation: 校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 受限膨脹與反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restrained swell and reaction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「受限膨脹與反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained swell and reaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間；若出現試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「受限試驗的峰值不受儀器剛度影響」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Peak restrained swelling pressure is independent of apparatus stiffness" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到校核試架柔度並同步保存試體位移、反力及水化時間，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check frame compliance and record specimen movement, reaction and wetting time together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「受限膨脹與反力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restrained swell and reaction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
遇水後產生的任何變形都只能叫做膨脹
optionsEn: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling
quiz.explanation: 試架變形釋放部分膨脹，誤以為地層壓力較低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Frame movement releases part of the swell and falsely suggests lower ground pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 力學軟化與膨脹區分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Softening versus swelling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「力學軟化與膨脹區分」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Softening versus swelling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 吸水後強度下降可能造成承載下變形，即使自由膨脹不大也會影響隧道。若只量高度而不記作用應力，壓密和膨脹可能互相抵消；試驗須比較相同應力路徑下乾濕狀態，辨認反應是體積增加還是剛度降低。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照相同應力路徑的乾濕強度、體積變化與破壞型態；若出現把軟化引起的沉陷當成膨脹，選錯結構拘束策略，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「力學軟化與膨脹區分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wetting can reduce strength and cause load-induced deformation despite modest free swell. Compaction and swelling may cancel in a height reading unless stress is recorded. Compare dry and wet states under the same stress path to distinguish volume increase from loss of stiffness. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare dry-wet strength, volume change and failure mode under matching stress paths. If settlement from softening is mistaken for swelling and leads to unsuitable restraint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Softening versus swelling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 對照相同應力路徑的乾濕強度、體積變化與破壞型態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把軟化引起的沉陷當成膨脹，選錯結構拘束策略」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.instruction: 膨脹反應需要可接近的水源，施工用水、裂隙水及膜後積水會形成不同暴露條件。流入量不是全部被礦物吸收，排出、蒸發和儲存都應列入水量帳；改善排導可能減少接觸，但不能保證已開始的反應立即停止。 判別這個機制時，應觀察追蹤各水源、流量及接觸區域，與變形時間曲線配對；若出現施工水滯留在仰拱下促進反應，卻被誤認為自然地下水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水源路徑與暴露量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

地表隆起除以總覆土就能得到唯一膨脹率

optionsEn: Lower measured drainage proves minerals have completely stopped taking up water
Surface heave divided by total cover gives the unique swelling strain

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instructionEn: Heave integrates strain through depth rather than applying one specimen percentage to all overburden. If treating all cover as active overstates heave while missed thin layers hide differential motion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Swelling-layer thickness and heave” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage compatibility and environmental effects" and "Long-term maintenance and reaction maps": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水相容與環境影響：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「排水相容與環境影響」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽排水可能減少局部水接觸，但也會改變有效應力、地表沉陷及水化學，不能把降低水位當成無代價方案。膜、排水和結構設計必須使用一致邊界，並考慮長期堵塞；評估應分開水量效果與材料反應效果。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量；若出現降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水相容與環境影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage can reduce contact but also alters effective stress, settlement and chemistry, so lower head is not consequence-free. Membranes, drains and structural models need compatible boundaries including blockage. Separate hydraulic effects from mineral reaction effects when assessing performance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. If dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
